title: Let's build a Chatbot - User Auth (Entra ID) (Part 9)

cues.en: Hi, and welcome to part knee of Let's Build a Chatbot in C-Sharp using Microsoft Agent Framework.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎來到使用 C# 與 Microsoft Agent Framework 打造聊天機器人的第九部分。

cues.en: So we can't really put this off any longer.
cues.zh: 這件事已經不能再拖了。

cues.en: We need to talk about user auth.
cues.zh: 我們需要談談使用者驗證。

cues.en: And the reason why I say that is I'm not that strong in user auth.
cues.zh: 之所以這樣說，是因為我並不擅長使用者驗證。

cues.en: Security has never been really my thing.
cues.zh: 安全向來不是我的強項。

cues.en: It's a necessary evil for me.
cues.zh: 對我而言，它是不得不做的事情。

cues.en: But luckily, I had Codex help me.
cues.zh: 但幸好有 Codex 協助，

cues.en: So it did most of the work in this one.
cues.zh: 這次大部分工作都是它完成的。

cues.en: It is fairly common place a server user auth, so it's nothing special there.
cues.zh: 這是相當標準的 Blazor Server 使用者驗證，沒有什麼特別。

cues.en: But of course, we needed to tweak a little about what we did in order to have that our files that we upload
cues.zh: 不過當然也需要調整，讓上傳的檔案，

cues.en: would be user-specific and that our conversations would be user-specific.
cues.zh: 以及對話，都能歸屬於特定使用者。

cues.en: So let's jump into the code, and let's just first see the site,
cues.zh: 接著看程式碼，不過先看看網站，

cues.en: which we have here.
cues.zh: 就是這裡。

cues.en: So now, in this system, we are now signed in as a user.
cues.zh: 現在系統已經有使用者登入。

cues.en: I'm right now signed in as one of my two users, and we will see me logging in with another one.
cues.zh: 目前登入的是我的兩個帳號之一，稍後會示範登入另一個。

cues.en: So we can now say hi.
cues.zh: 現在可以說你好。

cues.en: And that conversation is saved for me, and I can go in and choose an image.
cues.zh: 這段對話會保存給我，也可以選擇圖片。

cues.en: I have some tag clouds here.
cues.zh: 這裡有一些標籤雲圖片。

cues.en: So it can do the normal things.
cues.zh: 因此一般功能都能正常使用。

cues.en: But then if I sign out this account,
cues.zh: 接著登出這個帳號，

cues.en: and sign back in again here, I can now choose a different account.
cues.zh: 再重新登入，就可以選擇另一個帳號。

cues.en: Log in with pass keys here.
cues.zh: 這裡用 Passkey 登入。

cues.en: You can see there's no conversations here.
cues.zh: 可以看到，沒有任何對話。

cues.en: I can say, what is the weather like in Paris?
cues.zh: 可以問：巴黎天氣如何？

cues.en: Probably hot.
cues.zh: 可能很熱。

cues.en: And we'll come back.
cues.zh: 稍後就會回覆。

cues.en: I can log out with that account.
cues.zh: 接著登出這個帳號。

cues.en: And when I log in here,
cues.zh: 重新登入時，

cues.en: I can choose the first account again.
cues.zh: 再次選擇第一個帳號。

cues.en: And log in with that account, we have the first message, but not the second.
cues.zh: 登入後，可以看到第一段對話，但看不到第二段。

cues.en: So let's see how this was done.
cues.zh: 接著看看如何實作。

cues.en: So let's see how this was done in code.
cues.zh: 看看程式碼裡的做法。

cues.en: So auth, of course, always start in program.cs.
cues.zh: 驗證通常從 Program.cs 開始。

cues.en: So it added just build.services.addAuthentication,
cues.zh: 這裡加入 builder.Services.AddAuthentication，

cues.en: and it's using Microsoft Identity from my app settings.
cues.zh: 並從 AppSettings 載入 Microsoft Identity 設定。

cues.en: So in app settings, JSON, I don't have anything, but I have it in my development here.
cues.zh: AppSettings.json 裡沒有放，而是放在 Development 設定中。

cues.en: So what we need to do in order to get this is we need to go to Azure.
cues.zh: 為了取得這些設定，需要前往 Azure。

cues.en: Let me find my Azure portal here.
cues.zh: 先找到 Azure Portal。

cues.en: So I just made an app registration like normal up in Microsoft Enter ID.
cues.zh: 我只是在 Microsoft Entra ID 中，像平常一樣建立應用程式註冊。

cues.en: And all I really did in this one was I made the authentication, and then I made one redirect to URL.
cues.zh: 實際設定只有驗證機制，以及一個重新導向 URL。

cues.en: And right now it's only for my local host here, and then sign in OICD.
cues.zh: 目前只設定 localhost，再加上 signin-oidc。

cues.en: That's the only thing I did.
cues.zh: 只做了這些。

cues.en: I don't need to do anything with secrets or anything because it's Blazor server.
cues.zh: 這個 Blazor Server 範例中，沒有另外設定 Secret。

cues.en: It's very easy to work with here.
cues.zh: 這裡的操作相當容易。

cues.en: So if we go back, that is essentially just what we're loading up here, and then we're saying it's OpenID Connect that we use
cues.zh: 回到程式碼，就是載入這些設定，再指定使用 OpenID Connect，

cues.en: and various different things.
cues.zh: 以及其他相關設定。

cues.en: This little extra thing here is only because I want to be able to switch between my two accounts, else it would just lock me in with the first account all the time.
cues.zh: 這一小段額外設定，只是為了切換兩個帳號，否則會一直自動登入第一個帳號。

cues.en: We have authorization and cascading authentication state, so it works on all the views and all the controllers and so on.
cues.zh: 另外加入 Authorization 與 CascadingAuthenticationState，讓各個 View、Controller 等都能取得驗證狀態。

cues.en: And it's just Microsoft Identity.
cues.zh: 使用的就是 Microsoft Identity。

cues.en: Then, of course, once we have built the web application, we do the user authentication and user authorization.
cues.zh: 建立 Web 應用程式後，當然還要加入 UseAuthentication 與 UseAuthorization。

cues.en: And because we had the map get here where we get our different attachments,
cues.zh: 前面有取得附件的 MapGet，

cues.en: we need, of course, to have that require authentication.
cues.zh: 因此這個端點也必須要求驗證。

cues.en: In my case, I've also put in that I can get the user and check if the user actually owns that specific authentication,
cues.zh: 我也在這裡取得使用者，檢查他是否擁有這個特定附件，

cues.en: else we just say that that's not possible to get that one.
cues.zh: 否則不允許取得。

cues.en: Down in the Blazor itself, we just say we want authorization on the entire site.
cues.zh: Blazor 頁面本身，則要求整個網站都必須授權。

cues.en: So kind of easy here.
cues.zh: 因此這裡很簡單。

cues.en: Up in our routes, we have put in that instead of a normal route, we have put in an authorization route.
cues.zh: Routes 中，也把一般的 RouteView 改成 AuthorizeRouteView。

cues.en: And if we're not authorized, it sends us to a redirect login, which is just sending us to the Microsoft Identity login.
cues.zh: 未授權時，會進入 RedirectToLogin，重新導向 Microsoft Identity 登入。

cues.en: Again, this is standard stuff.
cues.zh: 這些都是標準做法。

cues.en: There's nothing special because we're using AI or making a chatbot.
cues.zh: 不會因為使用 AI 或建立聊天機器人而不同。

cues.en: This is what Codex wrote and what you would be able to find in various tutorials.
cues.zh: 這是 Codex 撰寫的內容，也能在各種教學找到。

cues.en: Beyond that, we don't really touch the chatbot as much.
cues.zh: 除此之外，聊天機器人本身沒有改太多。

cues.en: The only thing we really do is in the left sidebar, we send along the user ID.
cues.zh: 主要是把 UserId 傳給左側側邊欄。

cues.en: And the user ID is gathered by using the authentication state provider, which is how we get a user.
cues.zh: UserId 透過 AuthenticationStateProvider 取得，也就是取得使用者身分的方式。

cues.en: And on initialize, we just find who we are and get the user ID, which is just a small extension method on top of the claims principle.
cues.zh: 初始化時，找出目前使用者，再透過 ClaimsPrincipal 上的小型擴充方法取得 UserId。

cues.en: So once we have the user ID, we can send that along to the left sidebar.
cues.zh: 取得後，就能傳入左側側邊欄。

cues.en: And in the left sidebars, let's find it here, code, we send the user ID in to get our different conversations.
cues.zh: 到側邊欄程式碼，這裡將 UserId 傳入，取得該使用者的對話。

cues.en: Because what we do on the conversation parts when they are here, let me open one of them for you,
cues.zh: 因為對話資料在這裡，先打開其中一份，

cues.en: we are saving it with a user ID on it, so we know that this specific conversations belong to this user,
cues.zh: 儲存時會帶上 UserId，因此知道這個對話屬於哪位使用者，

cues.en: and so on and so forth.
cues.zh: 其他對話也是如此。

cues.en: So when we load the conversations, we can find all the ones that actually are from that user.
cues.zh: 因此載入時，只尋找屬於該使用者的項目。

cues.en: We could put it in a subfolder and so on, but I'm putting it like this, so at some point, these JSON files will probably go into a database, and then it would be easier to have it like this.
cues.zh: 也可以用子資料夾分類，但這裡這樣儲存，是因為未來 JSON 很可能移到資料庫，這種格式較方便。

cues.en: So that is how we choose among the conversations.
cues.zh: 這就是篩選對話的方式。

cues.en: All the files are in the same place, but only some of them are being loaded on the fly based on the user.
cues.zh: 所有檔案都在同一個位置，但會依使用者，只載入其中一部分。

cues.en: Beyond that, of course, when we make a new conversation, we put in the user ID, nothing special there.
cues.zh: 另外，建立新對話時，當然也要寫入 UserId，沒有特別之處。

cues.en: And when we go in and make the right sidebar,
cues.zh: 至於右側側邊欄，

cues.en: we have a little extra thing up here where we have to log in information.
cues.zh: 上面多了一小塊登入資訊。

cues.en: That's just a small component up here where we just show the name.
cues.zh: 那是一個小元件，用來顯示名稱。

cues.en: So inside an authorized tier, we can use context to get the user, and a link to a sign-out page.
cues.zh: 在 AuthorizeView 裡，透過 Context 取得使用者，再提供登出連結。

cues.en: So that's more or less the setup of this.
cues.zh: 設定大致就是這樣。

cues.en: The only other thing we really do is down in Services, when we do the file upload, we also give in the user ID,
cues.zh: 另外一個變更是在 Services，檔案上傳時也會傳入 UserId，

cues.en: and for the file uploads, we make a folder per user
cues.zh: 並為每個使用者建立一個上傳資料夾，

cues.en: in order to have it that that user's folder is in the files here, while the other's in a different place.
cues.zh: 讓不同使用者的檔案分開存放。

cues.en: So I've only given one of the two users a new thing set file, so we only have one here.
cues.zh: 目前只有其中一個帳號上傳新檔案，所以這裡只看到一個。

cues.en: So AI-wise, we didn't really change anything.
cues.zh: 因此 AI 部分完全沒有改動。

cues.en: This is just chore work in order to get user version up and running, and filtering out which uploads we have,
cues.zh: 這些只是讓使用者系統運作所需的基礎工作，並依使用者篩選上傳檔案，

cues.en: which conversations we have.
cues.zh: 以及對話。

cues.en: Right now, I'm just keeping all generated images still in VVVRoute, but it could also be that they should be kept to the specific user.
cues.zh: 目前生成的圖片仍然全部放在 wwwroot，不過也可以依使用者分開保存。

cues.en: But that's just a matter of preference.
cues.zh: 這取決於你的需求。

cues.en: So now we have a fully operational user system up and running, and we need that, of course, for a real-life site,
cues.zh: 現在有了完整可運作的使用者系統，實際網站當然需要它，

cues.en: but also things like user memory, which will be one of the coming videos as well.
cues.zh: 而且之後的使用者記憶等功能，也會用到。

cues.en: So with that, see you in the next one.
cues.zh: 下一支影片見。
